chapter_seo_title: Chen Jin Threatens Ji Ning’s Tribe – Forced to Swear a Heavenly Dao Oath | Desolate Era Ch. 239
chapter_meta_description: After losing the fight, Chen Jin threatens to destroy the Ji Clan using wanted criminals. Ji Ning’s cold fury results in a brutal ultimatum: swear a Heavenly Dao oath or die.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 239 – The Heavenly Dao Oath
og_description: Chen Jin crosses the line by threatening Ji Ning's tribe. Ji Ning’s response is absolute—no mercy, only a binding oath or soul annihilation.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 239 – A Threat Too Far
twitter_description: Chen Jin dares to threaten the Ji Clan. Ji Ning responds with divine sense fury and forces a Heavenly Dao oath. Read the full confrontation.

lore_anchors.definition: A spiritual cancer in Xianxia cultivation, born from unresolved rage, jealousy, or trauma. It blocks progress and can cause madness or death during tribulations.
A binding contract with the universe itself. Breaking it triggers immediate soul annihilation, making it the most absolute form of promise in Desolate Era.
A soul-based perceptual power used for telekinesis and mental attack. Ji Ning’s anomalously strong divine sense allows him to stun even a powerful Fiendgod Body Refiner like Flamesaint.
The Grand Xia Dynasty’s elite immortal corps. Their protection extends ten thousand li around each member’s home tribe, but clever enemies can bypass it with hired criminals.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, often referred to in non-romantic contexts as a cultivation partner.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, meaning ‘Myriad Manifestations.’ Adepts at this stage can resonate with the universe’s stars, greatly enhancing their power.
